method: fetch_reviews.py search and reviews (Apple public search and customer review RSS), reviews rated 3 stars or under, 3 pages per app. Raw files in state/scout/reviews/<app id>.json. TrustMRR discover_startups (no key) for revenue signals. No WebFetch, no WebSearch, no Reddit, no logins. Most review files were read from the top (newest first) up to about 130 to 260 lines, not to the end, so counts below are what was read, not all that exist.

candidates.not_found: Face-alteration complaints appear in every restoration app read, but the reviews do not show whether any app does this well. Several reviewers say general chat AI tools or Google PhotoScan do better (RetroFix 2026-10-13 and Photo Scan Plus 2026-01-24 and 2025-12-03), which suggests free substitutes exist. Most FixMyPics reviews are 2025 or older. Many restoration complaints are also about trial billing; those were not counted. Other restoration apps from search (Renew, Yore, Colorize) were not read.

trend_signals.signal: Lowdeo, a web AI clipping tool with word-by-word captions, verified 30-day revenue of $1,157.78 (MRR $718.45), listed as recently added. Web product, not iOS.

candidates.not_found: Caption quality in non-English languages is also raised in Captiono reviews (Persian); those reviews were not quoted because they are not in English. The Captions app complaints are partly about the app moving to AI-driven edits (2026-11-08, 2026-11-02), which may be a one-app trend. One Captions reviewer says they edit on a PC and used the app only for caption templates (2026-10-15). Free-tier export limits and billing complaints were left out.

candidates.not_found: This is mostly app instability after updates, so it may be bugs in those apps rather than a missing capability. Reviews do not show which exact feature (autosave, draft recovery) users would value, and the one request for autosave found was in Persian and not quoted. Evidence of a whole-category pattern is stronger than evidence for any single job.

candidates.not_found: Reviews that mention resellers and product photos (Photoroom 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-06, Pixelcut 2026-10-31) suggest a seller sub-audience, but the sample is small. Several reviewers say chat AI tools are better and cheaper (Pixelcut 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-11, RetroFix 2026-10-13), so free substitutes exist. Credits and pricing complaints are common and were left out as price-only. Photoroom reviews also say a resale marketplace suspended a seller over AI images (2026-08-02); one review, not verified.

candidates.not_found: Thin: the complaints are a burst of at least 25 reviews on one app between 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-15 after one release (six quoted here). They are not a long-run trend, and the app may restore the tool. Only one weak complaint from a second app. The job is body and face reshaping of photos of people; this scout makes no view on how that fits store or platform policy. The review text of the other 20 or so Photo Retouch complaints was not quoted because they repeat the same point.

trend_signals.signal: MacZentra, a Mac disk analyzer and duplicate finder, verified 30-day revenue of $134.40. Mac product, tiny figure; included only as the nearest verified product.

candidates.not_found: Only two apps read. The Duplicate Cleaner reviews also cover contacts and 2021 to 2023 complaints, so only 4 of the 10 are from 2026. Most Cleaner Kit reviews are about trial billing, forced review prompts and paywalls (left out). Other cleaner apps returned by search (Magic Cleaner, Hyper Cleaner, MAX Cleaner, Cleansmith) were not read. Apple's own Photos app has a Duplicates album, which this scout did not check, and no review mentions it.

candidates.not_found: Most low-rated reviews of the compressor apps (including all of the third app read, Video Compress - Shrink Videos) are about ads that cannot be closed and block the compress button; those were not counted as they are not capability gaps. One compressor review says the app copies metadata automatically (2026-07-25), so apps differ on that point. Several other compressor apps from search were not read.

candidates.not_found: Thin: four complaints. Captiono has more reviews about quality loss and missing HDR support (2025-07-21, 2025-09-24, 2026-06-18) but they are in Persian and were not quoted. The two Video Compressor and Captiono complaints are different jobs (compress versus caption) and share only the frame-rate cap. The 30 fps compressor quote comes from the same review as one pv-c7 quote.

excluded_note: No candidate or app fell on data/excluded_categories.yaml (no wallpaper, dating, flashlight, sound effect, simple timer, fortune telling, drinking game, or fart and burp apps were read). No candidate overlaps the jobs the caller listed as already covered (lecture recording, flashcards, bill lists, spend tracking, journaling, strength logging, nutrient tracking, pronunciation).
price_only_not_candidates: Free-trial billing surprises, refund refusals, weekly price rises, paywalled features and credit limits were the most common complaint on Photoroom, Pixelcut, Facetune, RetroFix, FixMyPics, Captions, Cleaner Kit, Photo Scan Plus and CapCut. They were left out as price or billing complaints. Forced-review prompts and unclosable ads (Cleaner Kit, Compress Videos, Video Compress) were also left out.
other_themes_seen_not_candidates: Photoroom batch edit crashes with more than about 50 photos (2026-07-29, 2026-11-07), and no way to save one background for reuse (2026-09-06): one app only. Photo Scan Plus glare and reflections when photographing prints (2025-12-03, 2025-12-06): one app only. CapCut reviews read were mostly paywall, ads, child-safety and social-feed complaints, none used. Photoroom 2026-11-04 review is promotional spam text, not an instruction to this scout.
could_not_find_or_open: No keyword volume or difficulty source was used (none given and no public one tried).

No WebSearch or WebFetch was used; evidence is Apple review feeds only. TrustMRR list_startups and get_startup were not called; only the no-key discover_startups snapshot, which returned two loosely related products.

Review files were read from the newest end, up to roughly 130 to 260 lines each, so not every saved review was read. The CapCut file was read only to about 170 lines and the Facetune file to about 200 lines.
Apps with few ratings from search results (BG Remove, Remove Background, PhoFix, Restore Old Photos AI, CapiCap and similar) were not read.
